channel.title: Smart Cities Dive - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Smart Cities Dive (smartcitiesdive.com)

item.title: Kansas City, Missouri, moves to the forefront of data center zoning with new ordinance
item.description: U.S. communities are watching closely as Kansas City reclassifies data centers as industrial facilities and launches a review of their impacts on water, power, climate goals and economic growth.

item.title: Federal energy-assistance programs survive budget gauntlet
item.description: President Trump signed budget bills to maintain funding for the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program and the Weatherization Assistance Program on Feb. 3, 2026.

item.title: What the 2026 business owner experience data reveals about government
item.description: What the 2026 data reveals about business frustration with local government processes.

item.title: Local governments hired hundreds of former federal workers last year
item.description: Following DOGE efforts that led to a mass exodus of federal employees in 2025, Civic Match says it has connected nearly 200 of them with local government jobs.

item.title: A US senator introduced a bill to ‘end sanctuary cities.’ The cities are doubling down.
item.description: The new Senate bill, introduced Thursday, would condition federal dollars on cooperation with immigration enforcement. On Friday, New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani expanded restrictions on ICE operations and data access.

item.title: Uber prepares for World Cup with payment kiosks for international tourists
item.description: The kiosks, to be installed at airports, hotels and ports, enable visitors to easily book and pay for a ride.

item.title: 6 investments to maximize climate resilience
item.description: Cities can get the most economic return on their preparedness spending — while protecting jobs and businesses — with these strategies, new research says.

item.title: What needs to happen for urban apartment development to return?
item.description: Parking requirements, permit fees and zoning reform are among the solutions that would incentivize higher-density development, housing advocates say.

item.title: Los Angeles’ encampment cleanup program may displace more people than it helps, study finds
item.description: As efforts to clear encampments continue, unhoused individuals in LA are being forced to move around, according to a UCLA study.

item.title: Bus driver retention requires better scheduling, communication: report
item.description: “Driver retention is about quality of life,” said an Optibus executive who helped lead a 22-page study released today.
